title: Construct Binary Tree from Preorder and Inorder Traversal
description: Reconstruct a distinct-valued binary tree and return its level-order array from preorder and inorder traversals. Implement `solve(data)` in Python. The input is a JSON-compatible map; return only the requested result and do not mutate caller-owned collections unless the task explicitly says in place.

examples.explanation: Applying the stated rules to this independently authored case produces the shown result.

constraints: Inputs use only the fields shown in the examples and deterministic tests.
Collections contain at most 10,000 items; text contains at most 20,000 Unicode code points.
The result must be deterministic for identical input.
